topics.title: Lexis, Vocabulary, Idioms, Figurative Language, and Grammar Structure

subtopics.content: General vocabulary across occupational fields, idiomatic expressions, figurative usage, sentence structure, concord, tenses, prepositions
subtopics.objective: Demonstrate proficiency in general vocabulary associated with building, agriculture, health, law, government, science, stock exchange, and sports; interpret idioms, collocations, and figurative expressions; apply correct grammatical rules including sequence of tenses, pronoun-antecedent agreement, concord, and prepositional usage; respond to lexical sense relations (synonyms, antonyms, homonyms).

sections.sectionTitle: Paper 2: Essay Writing, Comprehension, and Summary

subtopics.content: Letters, speeches, narratives, descriptions, arguments/debates, reports, articles, expository writing, creative writing
subtopics.objective: Write clear, coherent essays of at least 450 words in modern English, assessed on Content, Organization, Expression, and Mechanical Accuracy.

subtopics.content: Reading comprehension passage analysis, vocabulary replacement, grammatical functions, inference, prose summary
subtopics.objective: Extract factual content and make logical inferences from 350-word passages; identify grammatical structures (phrases, clauses) and their Contextual functions; extract specific aspects and synthesize concise summary points from 500-word prose passages.

sections.sectionTitle: Paper 3: Test of Orals / Listening Comprehension

subtopics.content: Pure vowels, diphthongs, single consonants, consonant clusters, rhymes, word stress, sentence stress, emphatic stress, intonation patterns
subtopics.objective: Recognize and produce pure vowel contrasts, diphthongs, single consonants, and initial/final consonant clusters; identify rhyming words; master word stress shift, stress-timed sentence patterns, strong/weak forms, and emphatic stress contrast; apply falling and rising intonation tunes to statements, questions, and commands.
